reviewer: Codex assistant pacing and layout review
scope: Reordered the 50 reviewed revision 9 boards into chapter difficulty waves. All 250 unique required words, layouts, tile multiplicities and bonus lists are preserved by source-board comparison. Revisited familiarity estimates for ordinary and less familiar senses. Every chapter peaks at its third board, followed by a recovery at least two score points lower; upward jumps never exceed ten points. Six tiles still begin at level 22. Five-tile recovery now occurs at level 29, with six tiles for the final chapters. Scores are editorial estimates, not player-calibrated difficulty. Historical saves migrate with solved credits, hints, coins and lifetime bonus progress retained.
